title: The implement dispatch runs from its spec

story.i_want_to: DispatchDriver and Placement to run implement@1 through the :build archetype
story.so_that: the claim and mint path is one archetype a new :build spec reuses

rationale: DispatchDriver (dispatch_driver.ex:127-548) and Placement (placement.ex:364-1125) hard-code the operator key, admission pre-check, runner advance and the claim. Placement.place/4 also has no kind guard: a non-implement kind would claim and then fail cast_dispatch.

acceptance_criteria.description: Agents.Dispatcher.run/2 handles :build: candidates, payload (:typed_story), refs (:derived_story_unique), operator key, Capacity.admit pre-check, advance_on [:runner_exhausted, :no_conforming_branch]; the claim and mint code is called by the archetype, unchanged.
DispatchDriverWorker's outcomes and the pushed payloads are identical to today's on recorded fixtures.
Placement.place/4 refuses a spec whose archetype is not :build with 422 not_placeable_kind before any claim; the place_dispatch MCP tool description names the refusal.
The custody fields written at claim (implementer_dispatch_id, assigned_agent_id) are unchanged, shown by the existing L4 gate tests passing unmodified.

test_cases.name: same outcomes
steps: run old and new driver passes over a fixture corpus

test_cases.name: kind guard
steps: call place with a triage spec

technical_notes: The MCP tool change ships in the same story (CLAUDE.md: an operator endpoint is not done until a tool calls it).
